svg.text: ESP32 Robot - breadboard hookup (SX1509 expander for unipolar steppers)
POWER NOTES (tags with the same name are the same net - use the breadboard rails)
+5V (red): external 5 V supply, 3 A or more -> all four ULN2003 boards and the servo V+. Do NOT connect it to the ESP32 5V/USB pin.
3V3: the SX1509 runs from the ESP32 3.3 V pin, never 5 V. The SparkFun breakout has I2C pull-ups; other boards need 4.7 kOhm from SDA and SCL to 3.3 V.
VM (orange): motor supply for the Easy Driver M+ (6-12 V typical, match your motor). Put a 100 uF capacitor across M+ and GND.
GND (black): ONE common ground: ESP32, SX1509, all ULN2003 boards, Easy Driver, servo, and the negative of every supply.
Fewer than four unipolar boards? Wire them from IO0 upward and set UNI_COUNT in config.h. Pin numbers match src/config.h.
